verdicts.reason: Both share the same failures: the cream circle is pulled out of the product group and parked as an empty blob behind the CTA, the Night Cream jar shrinks to a stray thumbnail far from the bottle, and the 'THE NIGHT SET' eyebrow sits at the bottom of the stack, below its own price. A also inverts the copy hierarchy: the product description is smaller than the 'Worth $72' line, and the jar floats awkwardly under the text block. B's copy sizes step down more sensibly, but its jar is so small it's barely visible and the bottle is jammed against the left edge, so it wins only narrowly.
